name: placement-keyboard-order-removal
description: The page places two surfaces, holds the keyboard call to the first one behind a held clearShape answer, and then places the second surface alone: the page sends the second syncSurfaces after the keyboard call to the removed surface is answered, and the host answers that call with null and the placement with its frame.
reason: syncSurfaces lays out the surfaces of a window and surfaceFocus gives the keyboard of the window to a surface, and only the native host with a window produces their answers (the native tier of docs/operations/examples.md#test-kinds).
